notes: Unique respondent identifier; maps to person_id as the primary key.
Data release cycle (survey metadata). Store as observation with custom concept for survey period.
Interview/examination status. Can be mapped to observation with custom concepts (e.g., 1=Interviewed only, 2=Both).
Gender: 1=Male (8507), 2=Female (8532). Map directly to gender_concept_id.
Age in years at screening. Calculate year_of_birth from survey year minus age. Topcoded at 80.
Age in months for 0-24 months. Store as observation with concept for age in months.
Race/Hispanic origin recode. Use to derive ethnicity (Hispanic vs Non-Hispanic) and race. Hispanic: 1,2; Non-Hispanic: 3,4,5.
Race/Hispanic origin with Asian detail. Use for race mapping (e.g., White=8527, Black=8516, Asian=8515).
Six-month exam period. Store as observation with custom concept for seasonality.
Age in months at exam for 0-19 years. Store as observation.
Served in US Armed Forces. Map to observation with standard concept for military service (e.g., 4181912).
Served in foreign country during conflict. Map to observation with custom concept.
Country of birth (US vs Others). Map to place_of_birth_concept_id (e.g., US=4337543).
US citizenship status. Map to observation with standard concept for citizenship.
Length of time in US. Map to observation with ordinal categories.
Education level for children 6-19. Map to observation with education concepts.
Education level for adults 20+. Map to observation with standard education concepts (e.g., 4071070 for high school).
Marital status. Map to observation with standard concepts (e.g., Married=4053842).
Pregnancy status at exam. Map to observation with pregnancy status concept.
Language of SP interview. Map to observation with language concepts (e.g., English=4180185).
Proxy used in SP interview. Map to observation with Yes/No concept.
Interpreter used in SP interview. Map to observation.
Language of Family interview. Map to observation.
Proxy used in Family interview. Map to observation.
Interpreter used in Family interview. Map to observation.
Language of MEC interview. Map to observation.
Proxy used in MEC interview. Map to observation.
Interpreter used in MEC interview. Map to observation.
Language of ACASI interview. Map to observation.
Total number in household. Map to observation as numeric value.
Total number in family. Map to observation.
Number of children ≤5 in HH. Map to observation.
Number of children 6-17 in HH. Map to observation.
Number of adults ≥60 in HH. Map to observation.
HH reference person's gender. Map to observation (not person table, as it's about the reference person).
HH reference person's age. Map to observation.
HH reference person's country of birth. Map to observation.
HH reference person's education. Map to observation.
HH reference person's marital status. Map to observation.
HH reference person's spouse's education. Map to observation.
Full sample 2-year interview weight. Store as observation with concept for survey weight.
Full sample 2-year MEC exam weight. Store as observation.
Masked variance pseudo-PSU. Survey design variable; not mapped to clinical data tables.
Masked variance pseudo-stratum. Survey design variable; not mapped.
Annual household income (range). Map to observation with income category concepts.
Annual family income (range). Map to observation.
Ratio of family income to poverty. Map to observation as continuous numeric value.
